senses.definition: The quality or state of being spiritual.
examples:
, "The Ways of Wisdom are Ways of Pleasantness"
a pleasure made for the soul, suitable to its spirituality

quotes.text: If this light be not spiritual, yet it approacheth nearest unto spirituality.

senses.definition: Concern for that which is unseen and intangible, as opposed to physical or mundane.
(obsolete) That which belongs to the church, or to a person as an ecclesiastic, or to religion, as distinct from temporalities.

quotes.text: During the vacancy of a see, the archbishop is guardian of the spiritualities thereof.

senses.definition: (obsolete) An ecclesiastical body; the whole body of the clergy, as distinct from, or opposed to, the temporality.

quotes.text: Five entire subsidies were granted to the king by the spirituality.
